## What We Do

We help local service businesses get cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity — the unified modern retrieval layer that now shapes buying decisions. We built and proved the system on our own real estate site (lametrohomefinder.com): 1.14M+ monthly impressions, citations across 4 of 4 major AI platforms, $0 ad spend.
